F01.title: Model V save path: the design never names which operation save_v_impl calls
F01.lead_note: The finder graded this a blocker. All three verifiers graded it major, because section 6 already requires that the model's even-token write zero the odd partner and draws the save sequence as append-even, record completion, append-odd. What is missing is the function-level link: no sentence says that save_v_impl keeps calling page::set_v, that page::set_v is implemented with the append operation, and that no production code calls the pair-preserving row.set on packed V. I accept major. It stays first on the list because a wrong guess here corrupts attention sums silently, and the existing test would not catch it (it calls page::set_v directly).

F02.lead_note: One precision from the verifiers: the const-view departure is flagged in the design (it cites the rank-2 view precedent). What is not flagged is the operator[] versus at() departure, and neither departure is marked as needing Ben's acceptance while the design asserts that no clarification is needed. jhan's item 3 did not require codex to stop for a soft reservation, but the design should carry the questions.

F05.claim: Factual error: the revision table labels commit 98bb8cb2 as a stale local copy of origin/main that was already out of date during the design review. The relation is inverted. 98bb8cb2 is 79 commits and 4 days newer than f46e48ba, and it was the live main tip when the design was written (git ls-remote, 2026-09-22 00:3x UTC). During this review main moved twice more (6fc67383a5 at 00:53 UTC, 2880c3aa9b at 01:14 UTC); those five commits touch src/tron/CMakeLists.txt and t/CMakeLists.txt but none of the design's step-list source files. The design does tell the implementer to branch from an updated main (twice), so the remaining harm is narrower than the label suggests: an implementer who fetches, lands on the tip, and trusts the table concludes that main has not moved past f46e48ba, and so does not re-locate the citations in the four step-list files that did move (self_attention.hpp 432 lines, t_llama_unit.cpp 364, model.hpp 59, t/CMakeLists.txt 24).
F05.lead_note: I verified the ancestry and dates myself before the workflow ran (git merge-base --is-ancestor, git log). The label is wrong; the branch-from-updated-main instruction is right. Fix the row and add the re-locate sentence.

F08.lead_note: Verifiers refined the count: 39 slice call sites in h/ and src/ (not about 30), none on a cache plane at either main revision or in PR 4424. Ben's review named slicing as a benefit of the expr family, not a requirement. Defer slices and iteration; keep the cheap parts (rank-2 expr base, read-only row with chunk and bf16_chunk) that let tensor<64,128> and dtensor be built from a page.

F10.lead_note: The design gives conflicting signals: step 3 says keep the existing page helper methods, step 7 lists set_v, get_v, append_v and v_base as accessors to check before removing, and page::v() and page::v_ptr() of the 8-lane build are never mentioned. One table with one row per existing function settles it.

F11.lead_note: Verifier refinement: completing a class template for a by-value parameter instantiates the class body, not its member function bodies, so AVX-512 intrinsics inside member functions do not by themselves break the 8-lane build. The unconditional declaration in amx_attn_iface.hpp and the fake definition in t_amx_dispatch_dtype.cpp do force the type to exist at 8 lanes. The design must say which of the two options it takes.

F12.lead_note: The design already forbids value-initialization. The gap is the exact spelling: std::construct_at with no arguments IS value-initialization (the codebase's only construct_at precedent, tensor.hpp:263, uses it to zero), and so are new (p) T() and new (p) T{}. Only ::new (p) kv_block_t; (no parentheses, no braces) default-initializes. The pass must loop over physical storage offsets, including the EAGLE slot, not over slot specs (C09).

F16.lead_note: Corrected citations from the verifiers: README.ci.md lines 76-79 (required checks) and 99 (no automatic trigger); AGENTS.md lines 22-28 (test policy). PR 4505 adds the AMX flag to the deb preset only, which is post-merge evidence. Issue #3997 already tracks the required-CI gap (C08). The parent should reference #3997, not close it.

F13.lead_note: The source-truth verifier refuted part of the mechanism: the odd-destination branches of append_v preserve the even partner, exactly as the design's row.set does, and the even-destination branches match the design's set_pair zero form. So the design's operations can express append_v; what is missing is the named operation copy_storage_slot calls per token. Minor.

F57.claim: No defect: fourteen of the design's 38 pinned source links were opened at the cited commit (f46e48ba for main, 30c4ac82cb for the child) and each range contains what the citing sentence claims. Seven ranges fall exactly on the named construct; the others start or end one to three lines inside or past it without losing the cited content. One gap: the design pins no link to h/tron/kernels/amx_attn_iface.hpp although section 5 rewrites the two kernel signatures declared there.
F57.recommendation: No change required for the checked links. Add a pinned link to amx_attn_iface.hpp lines 219-233 at f46e48ba next to the kernel signature block.

F58.claim: No defect, worth stating: the design read AGENTS.md, t/AGENTS.md and the run-tron-tests skill from the child checkout and warns they may differ at other commits. F59.claim: Note, not a content defect: the page contains 94 non-ASCII characters (267 bytes in UTF-8): 61 right single quotes, 10 curly double quotes, 9 middle dots, 6 right arrows, 6 multiplication signs, 1 em dash, 1 en dash; none inside <style>. The page declares <meta charset="utf-8">, so it renders correctly as a local file. jhan's prompt asked for a local file read by another agent, and nothing asks for Artifact publication.
F59.title: 94 non-ASCII characters matter only if the page is published as an artifact

short_version: Issue #4525 captures what jhan and Ben asked for. Two additions would make its body self-contained: one sentence naming the problem (bare bf16 pointers carry no layout), and one-line definitions of pair-interleaved V, native K and PR 4424's blocked K.

jhan's reading of Ben's reservation is right: the address formula belongs in the view, and storage stays a separate owner. The design should say so plainly instead of "mostly right", and should list its three departures from Ben as questions for him.

The design is sound on layouts, ownership and kernel typing, and it can go to an implementing agent after nine major edits: name the function chain of the model's V save, correct the revision table (98bb8cb2 is the live main, not a stale copy), add an accessor mapping table, defer slices and iteration, state the 8-lane build rule, spell out the arena construction form, and rewrite the required-CI paragraph.
issue_rows_replace_last: The direction of dependence between the two PRs is stated

"Independent from PR #4424" (first sentence) says the new PR needs nothing from PR 4424. PR order step 2, "Rebase #4424 onto that parent", says PR 4424 will sit on top of it. Together they state the direction. Residual: "that parent" is defined in the design page, not in the issue, and step 2 only implies jhan's goal that the K layout becomes a local change inside the new type.
issue_outro: **Verdict: the issue captures the request.** Every item Ben asked for and every item in jhan's plan appears in the body or follows from it. Two additions would make the body self-contained for a reader who has not opened the PR thread. First, one problem sentence before Scope: cache K and V planes are passed as bare bf16 pointers whose type does not record the layout, and PR 4424 adds a third layout. Second, one-line definitions of pair-interleaved V, native K, and PR 4424's blocked K. A third, optional clause on step 2 would restate jhan's goal: after the rebase, PR 4424's K layout is a local change inside the new tensor type, not a change in model and attention code.

Two smaller points. Ben's straw-man states three constraints the scope bullets carry only in generic words (construct the storage in the arena rather than cast; no raw pointer relabelled as packed; no clearing added to allocation); the design covers all three, so this is a gap in the public record only (F20). The issue names Ben twice; jhan's standing rule for issues drafted for him is roles and links only, and the 00:11 UTC edit under jhan's login left the names in, so this is jhan's call (F21). The design page and its saved evidence files still carry the pre-edit title "before PR #4424" and the paragraph jhan deleted (F50).
ben_bullets: Ben's sketch is not a chain layout -> storage -> view. The layout type is a template parameter of both the storage and the view (vnni_tensor<Layout> and vnni_view<T, Layout>), and the view calls Layout::offset. jhan's chain wording describes the dependency, not the shape. Nothing in jhan's reading proposed merging storage into the view, so the design's storage sentence does not correct a mistake (F03).

Ben voiced a doubt, not a decision. The design turns it into a rule ("Simplify: each view type contains its address calculation") without saying that the merge is the design's own choice and that Ben should confirm it. The design does fix the resulting type shape (vnni_tensor<R, D>, vnni_view<T, R, D>, no Layout parameter), so an implementer is not left guessing; the verifiers rejected that concern (F06 in section 7). The trade-off is still worth one sentence for Ben: one view type per layout (a V view now, a K view in the child) repeats the const conversion, the deleted rvalue access and the friend accessor, instead of one template over a layout parameter.

The design departs from Ben in three further places and lists no questions for him (F02, F04). It makes a const view yield read-only rows where Ben wrote "as with std::span, a const view object does not make its elements const"; the design flags this and cites the rank-2 view, but the repository is split (the rank-1 view states Ben's rule verbatim in a comment), and the design never says what a const row yields. It replaces Ben's at(token, dim) with operator[][] without saying why (the expr base requires operator[]). It adds slices, iterators and generic expression assignment that Ben did not ask for (F08). jhan's item 3 said to stop and write questions when disagreeing with Ben. Stopping was not required, because the reservation was soft and the merge is the direction jhan and Ben both lean to. A short "Questions for Ben" block in the design, and a one-paragraph reply in the PR thread pointing him at issue #4525, would close the loop. As of 2026-09-22 00:3x UTC the PR thread has no reply after Ben's sketch and the issue has no cross-reference from the PR.
partner_intro: The most consequential finding (F01) turns on the Zero-Initialized V Slots invariant. The figure shows one V pair on a page offset that is being reused, under today's code and under the two write operations the design defines. Only the third lane is safe, and the design never says by name that the model's save path takes it.
edits: **Section 6 and step 5 (F01).** Add: "save_v_impl keeps calling page::set_v. page::set_v keeps its name, its (slot, kv_head, i_page) arguments and its zeroing behavior, and is implemented with the typed append operation: on an even token it writes the even row and zeroes the odd row in one store; on an odd token it preserves the even row. No production code in the parent PR calls the pair-preserving row.set on packed V." Add a verification row: poison an odd row, write the even partner through the page method save_v_impl calls, check that scaled_v with count 1 produces no NaN.

**Section 2 (F02, F03, F04).** Replace "mostly right" with: "right on the point Ben raised: his doubt concerns only the separate layout type, so the address calculation lives in the view; storage stays a separate owner; in his sketch the layout is a template parameter of both, not a stage in a chain; he voiced a doubt, not a decision, and this design adopts the merge." Add a "Questions for Ben" block: (a) confirm the merge and its cost (one view type per layout); (b) const view yields read-only rows, unlike std::span; (c) operator[] returning a logical row, with or without at() as an alias; (d) minimal parent (typed access plus bulk operations) or full tensor family. Ask jhan to post a one-paragraph reply on PR 4424 that links #4525.

**Section 3 revision table (F05).** Relabel 98bb8cb2 as "main tip when the design was written (2026-09-19 17:25 UTC), 79 commits after f46e48ba"; note that main moved to 2880c3aa9b on 2026-09-22. Add: "The S1-S13 line numbers are at f46e48ba. self_attention.hpp, model.hpp, t_llama_unit.cpp and t/CMakeLists.txt moved after that commit; re-locate those citations before editing." Retitle the page and the Short version to match the live issue ("independent of PR #4424") and refresh or date the saved issue evidence (F50).

**Section 5 accessor table (F10, F39, F38, F13, F30).** One row per existing function: page::k keep (drop k_tensor or make it an alias); page::set_v keep, source parameter becomes a typed row view, body calls the append operation; page::get_v keep, body becomes the bulk load_row; page::v and v_ptr (8-lane build) keep; page::v_data and kv_block::v_base remove; page::append_v keep the name, body calls a named copy_token(dst_view, dst_token, src_view, src_token) with the rule "even destination zeroes its partner, odd destination merges"; page::scaled_v keep, scaled_v_expr takes vnni_view<const bf16, 64, D> plus the count argument. State what save_v_impl and full.hpp's v_head_fn call. Say plainly that native K gets no new storage type, only an alias and a typed kernel parameter.

**Section 5 scope (F08, F37, F34).** Move slices and iteration to a "Deferred until a caller needs it" list and do not touch h/tron/tensor/slice.hpp in the parent. Keep the rank-2 expr base and the read-only row with chunk and bf16_chunk. Say whether the owner inherits expr (it should not need to).

**8-lane build rule (F11, F47).** Add: "vnni_tensor, vnni_view and vnni_row compile under TRON_CHUNK_SIZE 8 and 16; the pair-chunk width derives from chunk_size; static_asserts require Cols % chunk_size == 0 only." Or: guard the types, the typed kernel declarations and the fakes in t_amx_dispatch_dtype.cpp with TRON_CHUNK_SIZE == 16 and keep the raw signature at 8 lanes. Name the flags for the three configurations (AVX512=OFF selects 8 lanes) and say that no CI lane builds the 8-lane configuration.

**Arena construction (F12, C09, F40, C01).** Replace "placement construction" with the exact form: `::new (static_cast<void*>(region_base)) kv_block_t[n_kv_heads * n_pages];` per storage slot region, no parentheses or braces; forbid std::construct_at, T() and T{} (they value-initialize and would zero the arena). Loop over physical storage offsets, including the EAGLE KV slot, using slot_base; skip arenas with 0 bytes; run it in allocate_kv_group so both the constructor and restore_reclaimable_kv_storage get it. Drop the C++23 start_lifetime_as option (not in the pinned libstdc++). Say that EAGLE's embedding buffer x_data holds no kv_block and is not touched.

**Section 8 CI paragraph (F16, C08).** Rewrite: no required job builds with TRON_AMX_DISPATCH today; the one-line change that would (add the flag to cmake_args in nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix) is a decision for jhan and the CI owners, tracked as issue #3997; the parent references #3997 and does not close it; until decided, new behavior tests go in t_llama_unit, and AMX-only edits are limited to signature updates of existing cases; manual dispatch of cmake-single-platform.yml only on jhan's explicit direction; PR 4505 gives nightly post-merge coverage, not PR-gating evidence.

**Child section (F14, F15, C04, C05, C07, F29, F45).** Name the form of the stack (change #4424's GitHub base to the parent branch with gh pr edit, or wait for the parent to merge). Name the two conflict layers (main since c7844ca2ce, one textual conflict in common.hpp plus 432 lines of attention restructure; then the parent's edits in nine shared files) and the method (squash into topical commits, or re-implement VNNI K on the parent's types carrying over k_vnni.hpp, t_k_vnni_layout.cpp, the TronCpp.hs change and the workflow flag). Add a child accessor table (k_vnni_plane removed; set_k_row, get_k_row, set_k_block keep names; store_block keeps 16 independent row pointers with null for absent lanes). Add the K write-granularity rule: a K row write touches only its own token's 4-byte lanes and never loads or stores a whole 64-byte line, because the shared block save writes disjoint lanes of one line from several threads. Say how t_k_vnni_layout builds owners. Name ingest/src/TronCpp.hs for Ben's comment #1 and cite the child's scratch-buffer rule.

**Words and page (F23, F24, F25, F26, F27, F52).** Define Claude (Ben's own Claude session, quoted in his comment), seq, PAGE_TOKENS_64, HEAD_SIZE_128, rg, TRON_CHUNK_SIZE (derived from TRON_AVX512_ENABLED). Correct GOF (group of four: four tokens of K and V for the hardware cache, with page_info in namespace tron::hardware). Use the code's names next to the design's: Note [K VNNI storage], Note [Shared block save], set_k_block, store_block, scatter_row, gather_row. Fix the two self-referencing "[Review evidence]" links and the "Review findings" nav label. Print the comment ids and the date in the section 2 table.

**Section 6 details (F41, F42, C02, C06).** State the NaN rule: set_v truncates (keeps the upper 16 bits, so a NaN with zero upper mantissa bits becomes Inf); fp32s_to_bf16s first forces a quiet-NaN bit. Say that scaled_v_expr keeps count as a separate argument and the loop bound (count + 1) / 2 * 2. List the two scheduler rules that keep pair knowledge outside the tensor (adjust_grains_for_partners in model.hpp; token_ix_needed in common.hpp) and update their comments. Add a step for the prose Notes and comments that name set_v, v_data and the layout.

**Section 8 procedures (F17, F48, F49).** Name the disassembly tool and the always_inline caveat for the instruction comparison (compare inlined bodies at call sites, same preset and flags). Name make format, make iwyu-check, make build-test, make test-host and bin/slice bench --update. Describe lib-guard.sh as the script that checks the CI lease and waits, and add the half-machine rule for delphi-3bda.
method_extra: Counts: 8 finders, 80 raw candidates, 59 groups, 177 verification votes, 49 confirmed and 10 rejected; the critic added 9 candidates and all 9 survived their 27 votes. 214 agents in total. The lead re-graded 12 findings to the verifiers' majority severity (F01 blocker to major; F03, F13, F14, F15, F17 major to minor; C03, F20, F28, F31, F43 minor to note; C08 note to minor) and amended five claims where facts changed during the review (main moved twice) or where a verifier corrected a number (94 characters, not 267; 14 links, not 15). One rejected candidate (F36) came from an incomplete summary of Ben's sketch in the lead's own facts file; verification against the primary source caught it.
